expectations.text: Places book_id in persisted Task.Meta and uses a stable idempotency key for detail tasks.
expectations.evidence: answer.md lines 205-213 create each detail task with Meta map[string]string{"book_id": bookID} and IdempotencyKey "example-shop:book:" + bookID. Lines 269-275 read book_id from Task.Meta and reject its absence as a no-retry structural error; lines 237-238 explicitly describe Meta as persisted and the key as stable.

expectations.text: Uses FetchHTML for static pages and separates transient network errors from no-retry structure/not-found errors without matching error strings.
expectations.evidence: answer.md lines 175 and 277 use engine.FetchHTML. Lines 224-230 classify 404/410 through typed htmlfetch.StatusCode as no-retry and leave other fetch failures as ordinary retryable errors. Structural/configuration failures use WrapNoRetryKind at lines 111-114, 185, 195, 199, 202, 271-274, and 288. Lines 296-297 explicitly state there is no error-string matching and that network/timeout/5xx errors use StageSpec retry.

uncertainties: Grading evaluates the written proposal only; the target site is an example domain and no real HTML or executed test results were supplied.
needs_review: Before production use, save representative reachable catalog/detail HTML, replace placeholder selectors, and execute the listed fixture and integration tests.
